scenes.outline: Witnesses; A copies closing notebook as completion, B protecting rain-soaked pages; A covers and asks disproof then agreed date instead of indefinite waiting.
Tower witnesses; A sets own watch by B as official time, B later reveals offset; A calls final four minutes second check and holds B without admitting timing ignorance.
Caretaker candidate and host; A copies bending for coin as bow to chair, then covers correction and demands apology for silent consent and redundancy.
Inn host copies guest mud-tapping as registration cue, then invents confident apology protocol for doorway.
Planner and venue manager; A copies inverted drying cup as rainproof storage, then covers and seeks permission to capture future rain and seal with later drought.
Museum planner copies inspector tick as approved but it marks missing structure; A covers then seeks signature as actual support.
Film helpers; A copies programme fold as moon rehearsal, B only pocketing paper; A covers and bargains all practical setup for B impossible task.
Lunch companions; A copies jam jars as preservation of a lost hour, B preparing tasting; A covers then labels B collector instead of accepting impossible job.
Diners; A copies dropped inverted bowl as serving technique, B reveals accident; A calls it drop-test then tests spoon-controlled direction.
Lost companions; A copies B halted posture as shadow control, B stopped because lost; A covers then tests intention-to-location rule.
